faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IRFC Head of Internal Audit (HIA) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the IRFC Head of Internal Audit (HIA) recruitment is 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by IRFC for the HIA post?
faq.answer: Indian Railway Finance Corporation (IRFC) has released a total of 1 vacancy for the Head of Internal Audit (HIA) post.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the HIA post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Chartered Accountants, Cost Accountants, or hold a full-time MBA/PGDM in Finance, or be officers from Organized Group 'A' Accounts Services.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the HIA position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Head of Internal Audit (HIA) position is 62 years.

faq.question: Q5. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply offline by sending their application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the IRFC HIA recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Head of Internal Audit (HIA) post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Head of Internal Audit (HIA) post will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the IRFC located?
faq.answer: IRFC is located in New Delhi, with the pincode 110003.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 03/2026.
